model_purpose: Source-driven measurement-likelihood calibration, not candidate-domain quantile adjustment or navigation scoring.
interval_semantics: left closed/right open; every GPS_GAL_BDS_DUAL BUILT record, eligibility only from source metadata
inspected_before_declaration: Only PLAN time coverage, not observation or residual values for these two windows. First100.198..109.998s is development evidence and dense-equivalence fixture.

models.covariance: Original Q plus one nonnegative common additive white variance on physical SD signals, transported through actual DD incidence.

M1 plus one common stationary OU SD-source variance and finite tau, mapped through true DD incidence. No unrestricted constant beta. Integer N remains integral in navigation; continuous N is integrated/profiled only for restricted calibration.

parameter_identifiability: One SD variance represents the sum of two indistinguishable receiver contributions. All amplitudes start shared across six signal groups to avoid six-group overfitting. Parameter combinations must have observable projected covariance derivatives.
beta_identity: Physical source signal identity, independent of integer arc token. Do not reset beta merely for a lock/TDCP integer slip; actual missing observations advance OU time with no fabricated samples.
tau_boundary_interpretation: A working calibration domain, not a prior proof of identifiability. Flat or boundary profile does not identify tau; tau below sampling interval is white-like and long tau constant-like.
held_out_boundary: Ten-second separation only makes dependence small under the finite<=2s OU hypothesis; no blanket claim of independent physical data.
objective: Exact restricted Gaussian likelihood with free per-epoch 3D baseline and full continuous physical integer design removed. No best integer, reference, subset passing or AR-domain outcome enters fitting.
efficient_engine: Build fixed per-epoch contrasts from original Q whitening and full QR nullspace of whitened B, independent of calibration parameters. Projected covariance is I+white_sigma^2 H H.T. Kalman innovations on physical SD beta propagate y and all float N columns as multiple RHS, then QR removes fixed-rank N. Objective includes logdet innovations and logdet whitened N information; fixed contrast-coordinate constants are parameter-independent.
equivalence_gate: On fixed first50 epochs compare beta=0 and one predeclared nonzero beta example with complete dense covariance, both residual cost and restricted log determinant. No calibration before equivalence.
validation_outputs: nonoverlapping same-physical-relation variogram shape at0.2,0.4,0.8,1.6s with full joint projected covariance
prohibited_claims: calibration or validation establishes AR reliability
a nonempty acceptance domain validates the model
two separate receiver variances have been estimated from identical SD structure
scope: Implementation/equivalence first; optimization and validation remain separate steps. No navigation run, no BYO/BYH/XB/NMB reads.
